item.title: Moon in Leo: meaning and what it says about you
item.description: Moon in Leo means the Moon was in Leo when you were born. In astrology the Moon stands for your inner world; Leo is a fire sign ruled by the Sun, warm and proud. Your heart is warm, loyal, and quietly hungry to be seen. Read more at astralroots.app

item.title: Moon in Cancer: meaning and what it says about you
item.description: Moon in Cancer means the Moon was in Cancer when you were born. In astrology the Moon stands for your inner world; Cancer is a water sign ruled by the Moon, tender and protective. You feel everything, and you remember all of it. Read more at astralroots.app

item.title: Moon in Gemini: meaning and what it says about you
item.description: Moon in Gemini means the Moon was in Gemini when you were born. In astrology the Moon stands for your inner world; Gemini is an air sign ruled by Mercury, curious and quick. You feel things by talking them through. Read more at astralroots.app
